references.summary_en: Gelatine from hides of lawful, properly slaughtered animals is halal; otherwise not. The scholars do not accept that making gelatine changes the substance completely. Where no halal authority exists, avoid gelatine.

references.summary_en: Gelatine from a slaughtered lawful animal is halal; from a lawful but unslaughtered animal it is haram, except from fish or bones. Gelatine from pig is haram. Gelatine is not made from plants.
references.summary_de: Gelatine von geschächteten erlaubten Tieren ist halal; von nicht geschächteten erlaubten Tieren haram, außer von Fisch oder Knochen. Schweinegelatine ist haram. Gelatine wird nicht aus Pflanzen gemacht.

references.summary_en: Balsamic vinegar is permissible as long as no effect of alcohol remains; the jurists say vinegar from wine is halal (the quoted Hidaya passage notes that Imam Shafi'i differs on deliberate conversion).

references.title: Askimam (Hanafi): once wine has become vinegar it is pure and permissible
references.title_de: Askimam (hanafitisch): Wein, der zu Essig geworden ist, ist rein und erlaubt
references.summary_en: When alcohol turns into vinegar, everything that made it impermissible is gone, so vinegar is pure and may be eaten.
references.summary_de: Wird Alkohol zu Essig, fällt alles weg, was ihn verboten machte; Essig ist rein und darf gegessen werden.

entries.notes: Hanafi: wine vinegar is halal. Imam Ahmad (Hanbali, our field MASHBOOH) and, for deliberate conversion, Imam Shafi'i differ per the Hidaya passage quoted in V102417.
